messages.subject: Renjin support for Holt-Winters and linear extrapolation methods for time series
parts:
Hi guys,
I noticed Renjin as interesting attempt to create a completely Java
implemented R interpreter. It seems that a lot of work is in front of
you guys, but I was wondering does Renjin at his stage support Holt-
Winters and linear extrapolation methods for time series analysis?

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Renjin support for Holt-Winters and linear extrapolation methods for time series
parts:
Hi Nikola,
Thanks for your interest!
I'm not familiar with the methods you mention below, are they are part of the R base package or a third-party package?
If they are written in pure R code, there's a good chance they will run; if they rely on packages written in C or fortran, those will have to be ported to R or Java.

Best,
Alex
